title: Why Cars Got A Third Brake Light
hook: A third light exists because two lights are genuinely ambiguous.

cast.note: Bill is a driver behind the car. The episode is about what he can and cannot read.

scenes.note: Establish the triangle: two low and wide, one high and centred.

beats.action: the rear of a car ahead; three brake lights visible
the high centre light circles teal
a triangle draws between the three lamps, showing the geometry

scenes.note: State the problem before the solution: the original pair are hard to read.

beats.action: the high light dims out, leaving only the original pair
the two low lamps flicker ambiguously; a question mark rises

scenes.note: Three reasons, three marks. The tail lights already being on is the important one.

beats.action: a LOW dimension line drops from the lamps to the road
a WIDE dimension line stretches between them
the tail lights light in the same coral, blurring into the brake lamps
the two low lamps and the tail lights pulse together, indistinguishable
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: The solution scene. The high lamp is DARK until braking — that is why it is unambiguous.

beats.action: the high light returns, dark and alone above the confusion
it snaps on hard; the low pair are ignored entirely
Bill's eye-line snaps straight to the single high lamp
the high lamp sits dark and steady above the pair
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: The optimistic number. Draw it as a bar so the next scene can shrink it.

beats.action: a row of taxi icons fills the street
a bar chart rises to a third; a big optimistic figure stamps beside it
more taxis join the row, each with a high lamp lit
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: HONESTY BEAT. The bar SHRINKS on screen. This is the point of the episode and it must be shown, not hidden.

beats.action: the bar shrinks down to a small fraction; the optimistic figure is crossed out
the small bar multiplies across a grid of cars until the total is large again
the grid holds, still counting; hard cut
the tall optimistic bar holds on screen a moment longer
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the grid of cars keeps extending past the frame edge
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap
